name: VC Deal Flow Signal
short_description: Track startup engineering acceleration from public GitHub data.
description: Surface breakout startups before they hit the news. VC Deal Flow Signal tracks commit velocity, contributor growth, and repository expansion across ~400 startup GitHub orgs in 20 sectors. Engineering acceleration has historically preceded fundraise announcements by 3-6 weeks. Free, no auth — backed by an open MCP server with five tools, three resources, and five reusable prompts.

tool_descriptors.name: get_trending_startups
tool_descriptors.summary: Top 20 startups across all sectors by engineering acceleration.

tool_descriptors.name: search_startups_by_sector
tool_descriptors.summary: Sector-filtered ranking. Sector slug from 20 enumerated values.

tool_descriptors.name: get_startup_signal
tool_descriptors.summary: Full signal profile for a named startup.

tool_descriptors.name: get_signals_summary
tool_descriptors.summary: Period, sector and startup counts, last refresh, format URLs.

tool_descriptors.name: get_methodology
tool_descriptors.summary: Methodology document covering data, metrics, classification, limitations.
